case_study_packaging.headline: Faith-based e-commerce retailer unlocks $1.24 million in annual savings—14% cost reduction delivered in under five months
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Christianbook, LLC had grown into a leading online and catalog retailer but still purchased freight, packaging, payments processing, and other indirect services through long-standing relationships and ad-hoc negotiations. With Nonantum Capital Partners seeking margin expansion, leadership needed a rapid, data-driven procurement strategy that could uncover meaningful savings without disrupting peak-season operations. Treya Partners was engaged to identify and capture $650K–$1.2M in cost reductions across eight categories in just five months.
case_study_packaging.client_problem_anonymized: A specialty e-commerce retailer had grown into a leading online and catalog business but still purchased freight, packaging, payments processing, and other indirect services through long-standing relationships and ad-hoc negotiations. With the private equity ownership group seeking margin expansion, leadership needed a rapid, data-driven procurement strategy that could uncover meaningful savings without disrupting peak-season operations. Treya Partners was engaged to identify and capture significant cost reductions across eight categories in just five months.
approach_summary: Analyzed 12 months of AP data to isolate $9.2 M in addressable spend across freight, merchant processing, corrugated, and packaging supplies.
Ran competitive RFPs and market benchmarks for LTL, FTL, packaging, corrugated, and merchant processing, inviting both incumbents and alternative suppliers.
Negotiated a switch from Chase Paymentech to Calibr Merchant Solutions, cutting effective card-processing rates by 0.30 percentage points and saving $628K annually.
Leveraged lane-level rate benchmarking to secure 31 % savings on LTL and 8 % on FTL while retaining service quality during the client’s busiest shipping months.

Partnered with incumbent box and packaging suppliers to achieve double-digit price concessions through volume-based breaks, avoiding re-qualifying warehouse SKUs and preventing operational disruption.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya delivered $1,237,359 in verified, contracted annual savings—more than double the guaranteed minimum and equal to a 3.3× return on the firm’s fixed project fee. Average reductions of 13–14 % were achieved across five categories while all changes were implemented within 120 days, allowing benefits to flow into EBITDA before the holiday peak. Beyond the dollars, Christianbook now has clean spend visibility, benchmark pricing, and a repeatable sourcing process for future waves.
where_we_were_unique: Captured first live savings within 120 days of project kick-off, meeting holiday-season deadlines.
Exceeded the contractual savings guarantee by 120 %, generating a 3.3× ROI for the client.
Balanced aggressive cost takeout with operational continuity by retaining key incumbents in sensitive categories.
Brought cross-category expertise—logistics, payments, and packaging—enabling simultaneous sourcing events that accelerated results.
